description:
Aggregate the work that delivers this outcome: events hold id and timestamp once around a tagged body, with a typed optional issue accessor.

## Background

This story groups the tasks of epic 2195c98f that share one design surface, so they can be reviewed together once each has landed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `Event` holds `id` and `timestamp` once around a flattened `EventBody`, and the body-view bridge no longer exists.
- [hard] REQ-02: The event issue accessor returns an optional typed id.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each line of this repository's event log whose tag is a current event type round-trips byte-identically, and the lines skipped by event parsing are exactly the lines carrying the retired tags `document_archived` and `lifecycle_timestamps_backfilled`.
title: Events are an envelope around a tagged body
